_about: Test tiles with centred connectors, each with exactly two openings, so every dungeon is a single path.
Three sizes (1x1, 1x2, 2x2), each as a straight (I) and a corner (L).
LG_I is an offset straight: north on its top-left square, south on its bottom-right square.
LG_I_01.png has a faint lighter patch on the top edge of its right square; it is treated as a wall.
Each tile is one shape; its 'images' are art variations, spread evenly over the tiles placed.
No 'copies', so each tile can be used any number of times.
name: Test01Linear
